The seed probes: the adversarial shapes the reviews of this milestone's
predecessors used -- a backslash with and without parens, `my ($x) = @_`,
and `keys %$r` in each context -- plus one snippet per marker that perl
does or does not build. The format is in README.md.

=== backslash array
my @a = (1, 2);
my $r = \@a;
--- facts
srefgen 1 exact
faithful

=== backslash parenthesised array
my @a = (1, 2);
my @r = \(@a);
--- facts
srefgen 1 exact
faithful

=== backslash parenthesised list of two arrays
my @a = (1); my @b = (2);
my @r = \(@a, @b);
--- facts
srefgen 1 exact
faithful

=== backslash my list
my @r = \my ($x, $y);
--- facts
srefgen 1 exact
faithful

=== backslash parenthesised my array
my $r = \(my @a);
--- facts
srefgen 1 exact
faithful
known-defect 01a167da-3323-7ce0-a627-abf5b99603d8

=== backslash constant folds away
my $r = \1;
--- facts
faithful

=== prototype forces a reference
sub f (\@) { scalar @{ $_[0] } }
my @a = (1, 2);
my $n = f(@a);
--- facts
srefgen 1 exact
faithful

=== list assignment from @_
sub f { my ($x) = @_; return $x }
--- facts
faithful

=== keys of a hash ref in list context
my $r = { a => 1 };
my @k = keys %$r;
--- facts
rv2hv 1 exact
anonhash 1 exact
faithful

=== keys of a hash ref in scalar context
my $r = { a => 1 };
my $n = keys %$r;
--- facts
rv2hv 1 exact
anonhash 1 exact
faithful

=== keys of a hash ref in boolean context
my $r = { a => 1 };
print "y\n" if keys %$r;
--- facts
rv2hv 1 exact
anonhash 1 exact
faithful

=== keys of a hash ref in void context
my $r = { a => 1 };
keys %$r;
--- facts
rv2hv 1 exact
anonhash 1 exact
faithful

=== arrow element read folds into multideref
my $r = { a => 1 };
my $v = $r->{a};
--- facts
anonhash 1 exact
faithful

=== lexical hash is padhv
my %h = (a => 1);
my @k = keys %h;
--- facts
faithful

=== package hash is rv2hv
our %h = (a => 1);
my @k = keys %h;
--- facts
rv2hv 2 wider
faithful

=== anonymous hash in map needs a plus
my @r = map { +{ n => $_ } } 1, 2;
--- facts
anonhash 1 exact
faithful

=== block in map is not a hash
my @r = map {; "$_" => 1 } 1, 2;
--- facts
faithful

=== bare match and bound match
$_ = "abc";
print "a\n" if /a/;
print "b\n" if $_ =~ m/b/;
--- facts
match 2 exact
faithful

=== substitution, qr and split are not matches
my $s = "a,b";
$s =~ s/a/c/;
my $q = qr/b/;
my @p = split /,/, $s;
--- facts
faithful

=== readline forms
my $l = <STDIN>;
open my $fh, '<', $0 or die;
my $m = <$fh>;
my $n = readline($fh);
--- facts
readline 3 exact
faithful

=== glob is not readline
my @f = <*.c>;
--- facts
faithful
